主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced on March 16, 2020, a reduction in its quarterly dividend and an expansion of cost reduction initiatives. The company issued a press release detailing these changes, which are part of its ongoing efforts to manage financial performance amid market conditions. The dividend reduction reflects adjustments to its financial strategy, while the cost reduction initiatives aim to improve operational efficiency. These actions are intended to support long-term financial stability and shareholder value. The changes were disclosed in a Form 8-K filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
